Q953.reason: A unit out of controlled cold storage past the time limit must go back to the blood bank for quarantine or disposal so traceability is kept; it is not transfused, re-chilled on the ward, or discarded in the sluice.

Q954.reason: Consent, perineal hygiene, and expiry checks are routine before catheterization; ringing next of kin is not required for a competent adult.

Q916.reason: 14–16G cannulae are large-bore devices for rapid volume replacement in trauma or burns, not for children, fragile elderly veins, or routine hand veins.
